title: Wed 14 Oct 2026: Chip sell-off, US CPI day, BoE hike bets and Budget, FCA AIFM deadline
summary: The Asian chip sell-off rattles Wall Street with Brent near one hundred and six dollars ahead of American inflation data. A Bank of England hike on 5 November is the market's base case, with the 28 October Budget and 30-year gilts above six percent in focus. The FCA's AIFM regime consultation closes, Connect becomes mandatory for fund applications on 2 November, plus ETF closures, three COO action points and the diary.
